properties.name: consent.based.authorization.enabled
properties.description: Whether ConsentAuthorizationService scopes auth-backend queries to the caller's current dbGaP consents and re-checks saved results against them before returning them. Maps from the CONSENT_BASED_AUTHORIZATION_ENABLED environment variable. When false, both checks are skipped for every backend.

properties.name: picsure.openapi.examples.categorical-concept-path
properties.description: Shown in the OpenAPI examples. A categorical concept path the query examples filter on. Concept paths are backslash delimited; in a .properties file write each backslash twice, while an environment variable takes the path as it is.

properties.name: picsure.openapi.examples.categorical-value
properties.description: Shown in the OpenAPI examples. A value of the categorical concept, used as its filter value in the query examples.

properties.name: picsure.openapi.examples.second-categorical-concept-path
properties.description: Shown in the OpenAPI examples. A second categorical concept path, used where a query example selects or requires two. Concept paths are backslash delimited; in a .properties file write each backslash twice, while an environment variable takes the path as it is.

properties.name: picsure.openapi.examples.continuous-concept-path
properties.description: Shown in the OpenAPI examples. A continuous concept path the query examples filter to a range and export. Concept paths are backslash delimited; in a .properties file write each backslash twice, while an environment variable takes the path as it is.

properties.name: picsure.openapi.examples.gene
properties.description: Shown in the OpenAPI examples. A gene symbol the genomic query examples filter on.
